I'm a full-stack developer with 3 years of experience building web apps and SaaS products. I've worked with early-stage startups and solo founders to take ideas from zero to a working product.

I'm comfortable owning entire features end-to-end — from architecture decisions to deployment. I communicate clearly, work async, and don't disappear.

Looking for: freelance contracts or part-time engagements with founders who need a reliable technical partner, not just someone to push code.
